unreleased.text: Editor textů přímo na stránkách: přepínač náhledu Počítač / Mobil ukáže stránku v šířce telefonu (mobilní menu, uspořádání) a texty jde upravovat stejně; volba se pamatuje. Texty pod otevřeným mobilním menu se už neorámují přes něj.

Texty webu: jeden upravený text jde vrátit na uloženou verzi bez potvrzení (odkaz v editoru, ikona ↺ v seznamu) a editor vypisuje Upravené texty – naposledy upravený nahoře, text z jiné stránky označený. Text přepsaný zpět na uložený se už nepočítá jako změna.

Texty webu, právní dokumenty a popisy produktů jsou čistý text: nový řádek místo
, odstavce prázdným řádkem. Web je vypisuje jako text, nikdy jako HTML; značky se při uložení odstraní a stávající texty převede migrace.
Editor textů přímo na stránkách: klíč textu u pravého okraje stránky (např. tlačítko FAQ) se už neschová za okraj – jeho štítek se posune doleva, aby byl vidět celý.

Editor textů přímo na stránkách: nová položka seznamu stránek „Lišta cookies a nabídka jazyka“ ukáže lištu cookies (i panel nastavení) a nabídku jazyka, takže jejich texty jde upravit kliknutím; tlačítka v editoru nic neukládají.

Přidání jazyka: kód jazyka má nově přesně 2 malá písmena (např. sk, de, fr) jako na serveru – jiné znaky do pole nejdou napsat. Dřív formulář povolil 2–5 písmen a server kód odmítl; chyba se navíc ukazovala dvakrát a s technickým textem.

Editor textů přímo na stránkách: chybějící texty jazyka se ukazují oranžově s českou předlohou a seznamem v panelu, chybějící obsah (Cannot load text) také oranžově; nabízí i vypnuté jazyky s tlačítkem Zapnout jazyk a celé okno Spravovat jazyky.
Home page: the second story of the About section has its own heading and text (home.about.story_heading_2 / story_text_2) instead of repeating the first one; the look stays the same.

Website texts and visual editor: leaving with unsaved changes asks first - Back of the browser, the menu, Open editor, closing the editor or a link to a part; a Back cancelled this way keeps the history in place.

Website text editor: a text in a button that is not a link (the question of an FAQ accordion, tabs) is selected and the button still works - hidden answers can be opened and edited; a click beside a text of a paragraph selects it.

Website text editor: options of drop-down lists (contact form topics) are listed in the panel as options of a list instead of hidden texts; the check of the pages shown in the editor frame got its own tests.

Website texts: new visual editor (Open editor) - the real pages of the website with every text outlined, click a text and edit it in the side panel with a live preview, then Save; content parts are linked. Not on a phone (a notice instead).

Website: editor mode for the new visual text editor - inside the admin frame every text of the page is outlined with its key (content of the admin in blue), a click selects it, unsaved texts show live; no cookie bar or analytics there.
Website texts: on narrower (not phone) screens the page could be scrolled sideways - the hidden, measured row of the part tabs widened it. The row is now measured inside a zero-size clipping box.
Website texts: the Languages window stays open under Add language, Upload JSON and the delete confirmation - a cancelled delete or a closed form comes back to the list instead of closing it.
Website texts: on wide screens (Full HD) the part tabs could stay a drop-down after it was shown once - the tabs now take the whole width, so the row comes back whenever it fits.

Website texts: Translations is a card like the other parts - the heading on the left, Discard changes and Save on the right; the part tabs become the drop-down also on wider screens whenever they do not fit; the language tabs scroll without a scrollbar.

Website texts and page titles: every part saves with the same Save and discards with Discard changes; short headings like the part names (Page titles, FAQ); on a phone the heading and Save share one row, without the unsaved badge.

Website texts: on a phone the parts of the page (Translations, Page titles, FAQ…) are a drop-down instead of a long scrolling row - the open part on top, every part with its missing count and unsaved dot, “+n” when other parts wait.

Website texts: the key column is narrower and long keys wrap at a dot; on a phone every text is a compact row - a small key above the text field over the whole width, a long key shortened from the left and shown whole while editing.

Website texts: the statistics of the language are one line, the search row has a Missing toggle (only the missing texts, together with the search) and next to Save changes is Discard changes with a confirmation.
Website texts: the language row only switches the language; adding a language is in the Languages window. The help of the page describes the new controls.
Website texts: language tabs show the flag or just the code (no letter stand-ins); on a phone they are one scrolling row with the statistics below, so nothing is cut off.

Website texts: a Languages button opens one window with every language - turn on/off, download and upload its JSON, delete. Download always gives the saved version; the open language warns about unsaved changes.

Website texts: language tabs only switch the language; turning languages on and off, uploading their JSON and deleting them is in Actions › Manage languages. The edited language shows in the save bar only while it floats.
Sticky save bars (texts editors, settings) reliably get their floating look (white, rounded, shadow) while stuck, in every browser and zoom level.
Website texts: JSON download and upload moved to the Actions menu; the sticky bar keeps only Save with the number of changes; on a phone Save is a bar at the bottom shown only with changes.
All tables (and the trash): short columns (ID, dates, labels, codes, prices, yes/no) are as wide as their content and never cut; text columns share the rest of the width.
Inquiries table: short columns (ID, status, priority, date) are as wide as their content and never cut; topic and e-mail share the rest of the width.

All tables on a phone: compact cards instead of the table (as in the inquiries); a tap opens the record, Select switches on bulk selection. In the trash a tap opens a window with Restore and Delete permanently. The trash shows translated values.
All list pages: a visible Add button next to Actions (on a phone a round green +) where records can be added, with the permission; it hides in the trash. Adding is no longer in the Actions menu.
Inquiries: a visible Add button next to Actions (on a phone a round green +); adding a record is no longer hidden in the Actions menu.
Phone: the page title and its buttons share one row, and selecting cards is one row (count, bulk actions, Done) - more records fit on the screen.
Inquiries on a phone: compact cards instead of the table (title, date, coloured labels, e-mail); a tap opens the inquiry. Select switches on selecting for bulk actions.
Menu: the same margin left and right of the items (also of the highlighted one), with the scrollbar or without it; the thinner scrollbar sits at the edge of the panel, off the items.
Menu: no scrollbar when the menu fits the window again (items have their former height), and a thin, quiet scrollbar without arrows when it does not fit.

Menu: a module with up to 8 pages (by your permissions) is one simple list without section names; long page names wrap to two lines instead of being cut. The menu is at least 180 px wide, so names fit.

Update times (“Updated at” under tables, dashboards, application checks) show hours and minutes without seconds, like the header clock. Log out in the account panel has rounded corners like the other items.
Header: your name instead of the e-mail (the e-mail when no name is set), no role badge and a clock without seconds. Name, e-mail and role are in the account panel; a changed own name shows at once.
Tables page faster: after changing the number of rows per page (and in the trash) the next page is loaded in advance, so it opens at once. Old cached pages are released from memory.

Table footer in one row: update time on the left, record count and paging on the right. Page buttons only with more pages, page size only when useful; full width is an icon toggle (hidden on phones, like the page size).

Tables show status, priority and severity as soft coloured labels: new is blue, waiting or in progress amber, done green, critical or failed red, normal and closed grey. The text stays; details and yes/no columns are unchanged.

Dates look the same everywhere in the administration: tables, details and the header show 24. 11. 2026 and 24. 11. 2026 22:51 (seconds only in details); English uses 24 Nov 2026. Tables no longer show a two-digit year.

All tables: click a row to open the record. One window is both the detail and the edit form, its actions (Delete and others) are at the bottom left; no icon columns. An open record has its own link and Back closes it.

Czech texts cleaned up: Dashboard is now Nástěnka, Edit is Upravit, Status is Stav, priority Neutrální is Normální, E-Shop is E-shop, and number ranges use a dash (1–12). The manuals follow the new names.

Language flags are shown whole (no longer cut off). The save buttons of Company profile and Data retention are at the top of the card and follow you while scrolling, instead of a bar covering the form.
Settings is now called Company profile (logo, company details, social networks, page titles). Data retention moved to Legal documents as its last tab, next to the privacy documents it belongs to.

The header is calmer: no language flag and no calendar button. Click your e-mail (on a phone your photo) to open the account panel with My account, the calendar, the administration language and Log out.
Personal information is now My account with the tabs Profile, Security and Preferences (administration language, pop-up notices). It is at the bottom of the menu in every module.

Page titles missing in a language are now flagged like missing texts: orange empty fields, a number at each language and on the Page titles tab, a warning above the list and the orange dot in the menu.
Deleting a language now removes all its texts everywhere (page titles, e-mail texts, slogan and copyright), and page titles are kept only for existing languages. The delete dialog says so.

Badges: a red number now counts only new records; work waiting for you (missing translations) is an orange dot at the page, the section, the module and the module switcher. Hover over a badge to see what it counts.
Text editors of the website and the e-shop show which language lacks how many texts, with a button that opens the language with only its missing texts.
On a phone the header has the menu on the left, the module switcher in the middle and your photo on the right; the photo opens your account, calendar, language and Log out.
One module switcher in the header: the button names the module you are in and its list holds Core and every application (also usable with the keyboard).
Help moved from the header to the bottom of the left menu, above Log out; the question mark at a page title still opens the help of that page.
Tables without records no longer show the pagination and a second empty message under the table.
Security monitoring has two tabs: Events (the table) and Overview (the activity chart and the retention); a click on a chart day opens the events of that day.
Every administration page has the same space around its content: titles and tables line up at the same distance from the menu on all pages of the core and the applications.

The manual page Website texts explains the language in the page address (/cs/, /en/, /fr/ …): how a new language gets its addresses, what visitors on the bare domain see and how to send someone a page in their language.

Search engines: sitemap.xml lists every public page in each active language, robots.txt keeps private pages (administration, sign-in, project portal) out of search results and every page names its other language versions. Old addresses without a language permanently lead to the Czech page.
The bare domain opens the home page in the visitor's language already on the server (browser language, otherwise English).
The catalogue and every active product are listed in sitemap.xml in each e-shop language; cart and checkout stay out of search results.
Links in portal e-mails (access link, project updates) open the portal directly in the recipient's language.
Product cards in the catalogue opened a missing page instead of the product detail; the e-shop terms link in the order confirmation e-mail opens in the customer's language.

Page addresses start with the language (/cs/services, /en/services). Old addresses and links in e-mails open in the visitor's language; a shared link opens in its language, with a one-time offer to switch to the visitor's own language.
E-shop addresses start with the language (/cs/shop/…, /en/shop/…); old addresses keep working. A shared link opens in its language, with a one-time offer to switch to the visitor's own language.

Portal and order-form addresses start with the language (/cs/projects/…); the portal follows the language of the website and its switcher changes the address. Links already sent to clients keep working.

The language switcher moved from the header to the bottom of the footer (languages by name, no flags). On a first visit the website is shown in the language of the visitor's browser if it has it, otherwise in English; a language picked in the footer is remembered.

The language switcher moved from the header to the bottom of the footer. On a first visit the e-shop is shown in the language of the visitor's browser if it has it, otherwise in English; a language picked in the footer is remembered.
New home page: a pinned hero where the admin screen rises and lands flat, content sliding over it, tiles arriving row by row. All web pages get calm scroll motion, off with reduced motion.
The public order form has the dark look of the website (colours and fonts); fields and sending are unchanged.
Sign-in, 404 and legal pages of the website use the colours and fonts of the website; small grey texts have a readable contrast.
JS Creator helpers: starred and recent templates, a default folder per template, length limits and hashtag sets for the post, brand colours, output filters and a kept unfinished form.

JS Creator generating: saved presets of the form (texts, library images, crops, text of the post – never photos) and bulk generating from a CSV or XLSX table read only in the browser – one output per row, photos matched by file name or library images by name.

JS Creator: carousel templates with up to 20 slides – one output with a picture of each slide, downloaded as a ZIP – and safe zones of TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts and Facebook Reels in the editor and when generating.
JS Creator library: images, own icons and fonts can be selected together, deleted, restored and downloaded – one file under its name, several as one ZIP.

JS Creator: templates, blocks and sets can be selected together and deleted, restored or exported as one JSON file; Import accepts only such a file, checks it strictly and gives a taken name “(2)”. Own icons (PNG / JPG) can be uploaded in the library.

JS Creator: an optional image field left empty no longer stops generating, characters the font lacks are refused, punctuation after a highlight stays on its line, no empty label, edits made during a save are kept, library popup buttons have texts, folder trash frees all space.

JS Creator, part 4: blocks (a logo, footer or label reused in templates - a change shows in all of them; fields in blocks, block from the selection, unpacking) and sets of templates in different sizes generated by one form, each size with its own crop.

JS Creator, part 3: generating posts from templates with a live preview - texts with highlights, photos from the computer (never uploaded) or the library with crop and zoom, text of the post; outputs in folders with a detail, copy, download, ZIP, moves and a trash.

JS Creator, part 2: templates of posts and their editor - texts with fields and highlights, fonts, images and image grids, shapes, gradients, icons, anchors, snapping guides, undo / redo, copies to other formats; library files used by a template cannot be deleted.

New application JS Creator (social network posts from own templates, no AI), part 1: a private workspace per account, output folders with a trash, a library of images, own fonts, 25 fonts with Czech characters, icons, quotas and an audit log.

changes.text: Unpaid bank-transfer orders: a payment reminder after 3 days and an automatic cancellation after 7 days (goods back to stock, coupon use returned, e-mail to the customer). The deadlines are set in Orders → Unpaid orders, the e-mail texts in Edit order e-mails.
The order confirmation e-mail and the payment reminder carry the payment details of a bank transfer (account, IBAN, SWIFT / BIC, variable symbol).

Shipping methods: delivery countries ticked per method. Checkout offers only those countries and, for the chosen country, only the methods delivering there; the order stores the country code and the confirmation e-mail shows its name.

Checkout: buying on a company (company name, company ID and VAT ID) and a note to the order. The company IDs are stored with the order and the customer, shown in the admin and in the confirmation e-mail.

The consent of the buyer with the terms and conditions is stored with every e-shop order - its time and the wording of the terms (date of their last change and a fingerprint of the text) - and shown in the order details.

Orange numbers also for the website content: FAQ, jobs, references and knowledge base items missing a text in an active language are counted in the menu and on the tabs of Texty webu until translated.

Upload JSON in the text editors is checked against the primary language: a file with missing or extra keys is refused with the list of keys and nothing changes. Download JSON gives a complete file with every key.
Text editor: the sample in the language name field of a new language follows the language of the admin.
The cart no longer writes a Czech debug message into the customer's browser console; technical messages of the e-shop are in English.

Product and variant images: the file picker offers only JPG, PNG and WebP, and a wrong type or a file over 5 MB is refused at once, before saving. Language and social network icons are checked the same way.

Logs keep no personal data from edits in the admin: personal fields of customers, orders, leads, applicants and other records show as [masked] also in the copy of the request, and database errors no longer quote the saved values.

Orange numbers in the menu for work waiting for you: website and e-shop texts missing in an active language (e.g. after an update) show at the text pages until they are filled; opening the page does not clear them.
Web and e-shop texts: an update also removes the texts it no longer uses from the other languages (e.g. German); their translations stay and new texts show there as missing until translated.
Web and e-shop texts: an update adds its new texts and updates the ones nobody edited by itself - texts edited in the admin stay, so uploading the JSON after an update is no longer needed.

Confirmation e-mail editors (inquiries, e-shop orders, project portal orders): texts typed into a language that had been saved empty before are saved again - the save reported success but kept nothing.
Confirmation e-mail editors mark the fields left empty in a language orange, show their number on the language tabs and explain that an empty field uses the Czech text or the default English wording.
The header and the buttons of the confirmation e-mail editor stay in place, only its content scrolls.
The inquiry confirmation e-mail shows the name of the topic (e.g. New project / inquiry) in the subject and the summary instead of its internal key.

Admin popups get one shared frame (first the confirmation, the password prompt and the e-mail editor): fixed header and buttons, Escape or a click outside closes, the cursor moves into the window and back, screen readers announce it as a dialog.

Record forms, record details, import, export and the charts window use the shared popup frame too: one look, Escape closes them, the cursor stays inside; the charts window has its title and actions in the header.
Calendar events, security event triage, the own password change, e-mail domains of administrators and languages of the text editors open in the shared popup frame too; the delete buttons are red.
E-shop order detail, order form and the order history of a customer open in the shared popup frame: status and amount in the header, Escape closes them and the page under them no longer scrolls.

E-shop product detail, form, variants, variant images and images open in the shared popup frame; variant images open over the variants and Escape closes only them; the page under a popup no longer scrolls.
On a phone the name of the current section is centred in the header of the administration instead of squeezed next to the menu button.

Red numbers of unread records in the menu (new inquiries, job applications, orders, low stock, overdue leads, security events) - per admin since their last visit of the page, "99+" above 99, sums at the module switcher. Checked once a minute while the tab is visible.
A pop-up notice at the top right when new records arrive; a click opens the page. It can be switched off on the Personal information page (only in that browser) - the numbers in the menu stay.

Project conversations in the administration: an open thread shows new client messages, replies and internal notes of colleagues and “read by the client” within 15 s - before, it showed them only after it was opened again.

Product and variant images are stored with the extension of their real content, and a variant image that is not a JPG, PNG or WebP is refused - before, an uploaded file could be stored under a name like .html or .js and run in the browser as part of the website.
Language flag icons are stored with the extension of their real content, and every public upload (images, flags) is served so that it can never run as a page or script.

The checkout checks the stock for the whole quantity of a product even when the order sends it in several lines (such an order could take more pieces than were in stock, the stock went below zero) and saves them as one item; a product with variants can be ordered only as one of its variants.
A coupon with a limited number of uses can no longer be used more times than allowed by orders sent at the same moment - the use is counted together with the check of the limit.

The audit log keeps no copy of the contact data, messages and file names sent with an inquiry or a job application, and the log of a new application names only the position - an erased inquiry or application leaves no personal data in the log.
The audit log of the checkout keeps no copy of the buyer’s contact data - an anonymised customer leaves no personal data in the log.
The audit log of the order form keeps no copy of the client’s data and file names; the log row names the order by its number.
Exports to CSV and TXT show a value that a spreadsheet would run as a formula (it starts with =, +, -, @) as plain text - an apostrophe is put in front; the import removes it again.

A deleted sysadmin account can be restored from the trash only by another sysadmin (the same rule as deleting it), and deleting an account signs it out on every device at once - a restore no longer brings its old sessions back.

The checkout is protected like the other public forms: an invisible bot check, a hidden trap field, at most 5 attempts per minute per visitor and 3 orders per hour (10 per day) to one e-mail - nobody can make the e-shop mail strangers or use up the stock with fake orders.

The core log has its own permission (View the core log): the Core tab alone no longer opens it. Roles with the Core tab get it with the update. A failed sign-in names the e-mail only of an existing account; any other typed text is logged as an unreadable code.
The internal note of an administrator account is shown only to the sysadmin and to accounts that may view the administrators - the account itself no longer receives it.

Tabs, filters and language switches of the administration have one look: a grey bar with icon buttons, the selected one white (settings, releases, calendar, legal documents, translation and content editors, project page, orders).

Every confirmation with your password (switching an application on / off, operations on system administrators, the e-mail access policy) uses the same window; a wrong password is shown right under the field.

Edit website has a new tab Knowledge base: the introduction and the blocks of the public help page (heading, text, optional sub-blocks and an image at the end of a block) are edited in every language, blocks can be reordered or hidden.
The help page (/knowledge-base) shows the content edited in the administration, with an optional image at the end of a block; the glossary was removed.
The Applications page refreshes the state of every application by itself every 10 seconds.
Account activation and password reset have the same look as the sign-in page: logo on the left, the form on the right, language switcher in the corner.
The sign-in page of the project portal has the same look as the other sign-in pages, with a language switcher.
New maintenance page in the colours of the website: logo, a short notice, language switcher and contacts; the page now has the address /maintenance.
The maintenance page of the e-shop has the same look as the website and the address /shop/maintenance.
The maintenance page of the project portal has the same look as the website.
Releases page (Core → Releases): the running version and what changed in every release; the version is shown in the sidebar and a short notice appears after an update of the part you work in.
Passwords of administrator accounts may have up to 64 characters (was 16), so password managers and passphrases can be used.

Nightly maintenance jobs (GDPR retention clean-up, security events, expired sign-in data, orphan files) stopped with "Table 'cache_locks' doesn't exist" in System logs; the missing table is created and the jobs run again.
New sign-in page of the administration: split layout, language switcher and the remembered accounts above the form; all texts translated.
Sign-in of a project has its own page (/projects/login/…); a link to the portal without a valid session opens it and keeps the requested section.
First release on the own server: automatic deployment with a backup before every release and an automatic return to the previous version when a release fails.
Applications page: state of every application, light diagnostics and the maintenance switch; the switch is also in the header of every dashboard.
Answers to e-mails of the application go to the info address of the domain (Reply-To).
Dashboard of the project portal and its maintenance switch.
Maintenance page of the project portal while it is switched off.
